scope: Exploratory concurrent paired three-seed comparison. Same frozen EMA, fresh Adam, data and training RNG, 6000 updates. Zero-initialized data-derived local dot/mask input. No Hamiltonian or new loss penalty. Equal updates, not equal FLOPs. No best-seed choice or promotion.
evaluation: After all six training tasks complete, evaluate all seeds on fixed development initial families with paired latent seeds, 128 paths/family, 1024 steps, first800 and full16000. Compare spatial/temporal moments, magnetization diversity, sign events and runtime. Reused development is not final certification. No GO from loss.
